text.en: You can select the assault doctrine or tactical doctrine one additional time per battle. Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER units have +1 to advance rolls. Friendly SUBODEN KHAN units have the following ability: Wrath of the First Khan: At the end of the Fight phase, if this unit was eligible to fight this…
ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This unit can re-roll advance rolls.
ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit only. When this unit is selected to make an ingress move, treat the current battle round number as being one higher than it actually is.
ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This unit’s ranged attacks: Have [IGNORES COVER]. Have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This model’s melee attacks have: +1 S and AP. Or: If this unit made a charge move this turn, +2 S and AP.
